test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for ‘apprehension’ in the given sentence.**

Shradha was never in such a situation before; her excitement was understandable for her peers.
solution: The correct answer is **"Excitement."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Apprehension"** means fear or anxiety about something uncertain. (संशय, भय, चिंता) • **Example**: *It's normal to feel a little **apprehension**__ before starting a new job.* • The antonym of **"Apprehension" **must be** "Excitement."** • **"Excitement"** means the state of being excited, especially because something interesting is happening or will happen. (उत्तेजना, उत्‍साहमयी प्रसन्‍नता) __ • **Example**:* There was great **excitement**__ as the winner’s name was announced.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Before: **earlier than somebody/something; earlier than the time that. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से पहले; किसी समय-बिंदु से पहले) • **Peers: **a person who is of the same age or position in society as you. (व्‍यक्ति जो समाज में समान स्‍थान पर या आयु का हो; समकक्ष व्‍यक्ति) • **Situation: **the things that are happening in a particular place or at a particular time. (स्‍थान-विशेष में या समय-विशेष पर घटित होने वाली घटनाएँ; स्थिति, दशा, हालत) 38:Tb27, The correct answer is** "Only a few students passed the test."**
